item: secp truth interaction generator: batch-inverted (BYTE inverse dictionary + 32-row Wire35 batch inversion) and row-chunk parallel under the scoped work pool
workload: prefix4 (4 CPU proofs + 3 truth proofs: physical-0004 non-secp truth, physical-0005 and physical-0006 secp truth)
harness: lockf -k /private/tmp/stwo-rv64-perf-heavy.lock /usr/bin/time -l rv64-word16-ethereum produce <round5 request> <round5 jobs> <fresh dir> 4

stage_deltas.targeted_stage: interaction_generation in physical-0005 + physical-0006 (secp truth proofs)

conclusion: Byte-identical proofs in all four runs. The targeted stage drops from ~1.17 s to ~0.04 s summed over the two secp truth proofs (~31x). Prefix4 wall means are 26.59 s (A) vs 25.55 s (B), about -1.0 s, but A1/A2 spread is 3.5% (under the 5% noise flag, yet comparable to the delta) and the machine may be shared, so the wall gain is suggestive rather than established; user CPU is flat. Prefix4 contains only 3 truth proofs (2 secp), so this does not measure the full-block secp tail where interaction generation was reported at ~9.1 s (add) and ~3.6 s (double); the expected full-block saving should be re-measured on the full block.
